meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理 BIDS 数据集：组织神经影像与电生理数据、查询布局、验证合规性、将 DICOM 转为 BIDS、编写 JSON 元数据、生成 derivatives，并给出具体命令。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BIDS 数据集，如整理神经影像、查询布局或验证合规性时触发。

say.text: 请帮我把这个 DICOM 文件夹按 BIDS 规范转换并组织好。
say.note: 会运行 DICOM 转 BIDS 工具。

say.text: 用 PyBIDS 查询这个数据集里所有 T1w 文件，列出路径。
say.note: 会调用 PyBIDS 查询布局。

say.text: 验证一下这个 BIDS 数据集是否合规，并给出报告。

howto.what_en: Claude can organize BIDS datasets (MRI, EEG, etc.), query layouts, validate compliance, convert DICOM to BIDS, write JSON sidecars, and create derivatives, with concrete commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work with BIDS datasets, e.g., organizing neuroimaging data, querying layouts, or validating compliance.

say_en.text: Please convert this DICOM folder into BIDS format and organize it.
say_en.note: This will run a DICOM-to-BIDS converter.

say_en.text: Use PyBIDS to find all T1w files in this dataset and list their paths.
say_en.note: This will query the BIDS layout with PyBIDS.

say_en.text: Validate this BIDS dataset and show the compliance report.
